title: SFX Sound Definition
description: Contract for sfx/sounds/<id>/config.json — one file per catalogued sound.

sound.description: Canonical id. Also controls cue reference: { "sound": "<id>" }

aliases.description: Alternate cue spellings the engine accepts (e.g. "swoosh" for whoosh).

backend.description: sample = bundled CC0 asset; tone = Tone.js/WebAudio recipe (sfx/sounds/<id>/recipe.mjs).

recipe.description: tone backend: design name (implementation is sfx/sounds/<id>/recipe.mjs).

asset.description: sample backend: path inside sfx/assets/ (subdirectories allowed, e.g. 'pack/games/coin.mp3'; must exist and match manifest.json SHA-256).

source.description: Provenance of an imported asset: original pack path or URL. Informational only.

level.description: Sample-backend loudness metadata. Omit for the engine's default automatic law ('auto').

mode.description: auto = render-time loudness matching against the measured voiceover; peak = legacy 0.9 peak normalization.

trim_db.description: Per-sound offset applied after loudness matching (positive = deliberately hotter).

measured.description: Informational analysis written by scripts/import_sfx_pack.py (never used for gain math).

tags.description: Auditory category tags: transition, emphasis, impact, ui, organic, riser, glitch, ambient, accent.

moods.description: Which scene moods this sound fits. 'neutral' fits everything. 'glitch' is a visual-treatment mood reserved for catalog sounds — never a video or scene mood.

default_volume.description: Applied when a cue omits volume.

max_tail_seconds.description: Generated/dried length of the sound; used for video-end tail handling.

params.description: Optional per-sound parameters. Each value is a param definition.

description.description: One line: what it sounds like + when to use. Written for an LLM that cannot listen.
